concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-local-payment-methods-client-side-custom-android-v5]] - Android v5 custom client-side Local Payment Methods guide for merchant-owned UI, request/return handling and nonce handoff to separate server responsibilities, with unresolved client-page webhook versus server-page Payment Context API alternative wording
warnings: Place this alongside the existing Local Payment Methods article source; the article remains the product owner and this versioned guide remains a separate implementation route.
Do not treat authorization-flow initiation, successful return tokenization or nonce receipt as proof of payment completion, settlement or funding.

Preserve the unresolved source conflict: the Android client page says Braintree webhooks must be implemented, while the fully read Node server page says the Payment Context GraphQL API can be used as an alternative to webhooks; neither source establishes whether that alternative replaces every webhook responsibility or only Payment Context updates.
The captured page does not document instant-versus-non-instant completion semantics, and its website Android v5 route is not current package-support evidence.
Preserve the dated certificate warning and the unresolved Kotlin 5.8.0 versus Groovy 5.2.0 dependency-example difference in the source page rather than selecting a common SDK baseline.
